title: Trivia about Todd and Vincent
text:
Abel can recruit the main story Todd as an ally, despite him having hostilities against Subaru, but even while being obedient to Abel, Todd might kill Subaru secretly.

Also, in terms of Todd beign a werewolf, Todd doesn't really care about others of his kind, other than his very being is one that is targeted. He doesn't resent Abel either, in fact, he seems to respect him, since Abel doesn't seem to have any real reason to want to discriminate against werewolves.
